{"id":1766720353,"question_id":279,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"10 months, 1 week","timestamp":1757564124,"status":14,"status_display":"Time Limit Exceeded","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/1766720353/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Perfect Squares","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int solve(int n)\n    {\n        //base case\n        if(n == 0) return 1;\n        if(n < 0) return 0;\n    \n        //ek case hum solve karenge baaki recursion kardega\n        int steps = 0;\n        int ans = INT_MAX;\n\n        for(int i=1 ; i<=sqrt(n) ; i++)\n        {\n            int square = i * i;\n            steps = 1 + solve(n - square);\n            ans = min(ans , steps);\n        } \n    return ans;\n    }\n\n    int numSquares(int n) {\n        return solve(n) - 1;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"perfect-squares","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":778}
